# The utility scales

Read from:
- `src/static/less/utils.less`

These are the only steps the product can express with a class. A value that is
not here has to be written as a literal in a component, and most are not.

## Spacing — `.p-` `.px-` `.py-` `.m-` `.mt-` `.mb-` `.my-`

```
0 2 4 8 12 16 20 24 32 40 48 54
```

Plus, for `.mt-` `.mb-` `.pb-` only:

```
0 20 25 30
```

Every one emits `!important`. `0` emits a bare `0`, the rest `n * 1px`.

## Font size — `.fz-` and `.fs`

```
10 12 13 14 16 18 20 24
```

No `!important`. `.fz-16` is `font-size: 16px`.

## Font weight

| class | emits |
|---|---|
| `.fw-400` | 400 |
| `.fw-500, .fw-medium` | 500 |
| `.fw-600, .semiBold` | 600 |
| `.fw-700, .bold` | 700 |
| `.fw-800, .heavy` | 800 |
| `.fw-900` | 800 — **the class name and the value disagree; mirror it, do not correct it** |
